text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Peace has returned to Elizabeth Park. While the other guild members
are hard at work, Rin is living the lazy life to the best of her ability.
text_block_list.orig_text:
平和を取り戻した牧場で、ギルドメンバーが各々の仕事に取り組む中、
リンは存分にぐうたらライフを満喫していた。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* It sure is peaceful.
Nothing tastes better than acorns eaten while reveling in tranquility.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～、
平和だねぇ。
平和を享受しながら食べるドングリは
格別だよ～

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
I know the armor my mom gave me helped us grasp an unexpected
victory, but as it turns out, I'm not a fan of conflict.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前は
ママからもらった鎧のおかげで
たまたま活躍しちゃったけど、
やっぱ戦いなんてまっぴらごめんだねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Not needing to wear armor is evidence of peaceful times.
So for the rest of my days, it'll just be an ornament in my room.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鎧を着なくていいのは平和の証、
これからは部屋のインテリアとして
余生を過ごしてよね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What the heck, man?
Like, I know we're friends and whatnot, but you could still at least knock.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ！　
ビックリしたぁ……
あんたねぇ、
いくらあたしが相手とはいえ、
ノックくらいしてよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
I'm a squirrel, you know? A tiny little animal.
I'm really sensitive, so treat me with a little more delicacy, okay?
choice_data_list: I've got a letter for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしゃリスだよ？　
小動物だよ？
ナイーブなんだから
デリケートに扱ってよね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, are you listening? Show some consideration, geez.
Well anyway, let's see where the letter's from... Uh-oh, it's from Caon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや聞いてよ。
どこまでマイペースなのさ、
あんたは。
で、
手紙ってどこから……
げ、
【自警団（カォン）】からじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh, I don't wanna read it...
There can't be anything good written inside.
What could it be...? Huh? A job request?! Why me?!
choice_data_list: 'Cause you've had a lot of success recently?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ～、
読みたくない……
絶対ろくなこと書いてないよ。
なになに……
は？　
仕事の依頼！？　
何であたしに！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, you've gotta be kidding me. That was all thanks to Mahy and the
others. I basically did nothing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぇ～、
冗談じゃないよ。
あれはまっひ～たちががんばっただけで、
あたしは全然大したことしてないのに。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Argh, come on! Things have [i]just[/i] started to go back to normal.
Leave me alone.
choice_data_list: They'll be angry if you don't go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
やだやだ。
せっかく平和な日常が戻ってきたんだ、
もうほっといてよ～

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Right, if you actually believe that, then there's clearly
something wrong with you. Go stuff yourself full of acorns.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
本気でそう思ってるなら、
あんたの目は節穴だね。
ドングリでも詰めておきなよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you don't have to tell me...
But *sob*... I don't wanna do any work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かってるけどさ……
でもでも、
うぅ……
働きたくな～い！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, hell if I go, hell if I don't. I'm screwed either way.
Man, what did I do to deserve this?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐぬぬ、
行っても地獄、
行かなくても地獄の八方塞がりじゃん。
ひどい、
あたしが何したっていうのさ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, you've been staring at my armor for a while now.
What gives?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ところであんた、
どうしてさっきからあたしの鎧をじっと見てるの？

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's nothing more than a decoration now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うって、
それはもうただのインテリアで……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Argh, man, I can't be bothered explaining!
If I don't do it, they'll force me back into training,
so let's just get it over with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
もう、
説明するのも面倒くさい！
サボったらまた訓練させられるし、
さっさと済ませちゃおう。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
I know, I can use the situation to my advantage.
Even if the mission fails, they might still appreciate my motivation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
せっかくだし鎧着てこう。
もし任務が失敗しても、
やる気はあったって評価してくれるかもね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: But [i]this time[/i] is definitely the last time I wear this armor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度こそ、
これを着るのは最後にしたいよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Lemme see, the job is to rescue a couple of stranded people, right?
I'm just glad it wasn't an extermination request.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
仕事は遭難者の救出だったね。
魔物退治とかじゃなくてよかった～

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they've chosen a mission that plays to my strengths,
but their consideration is misplaced.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一応あたしが得意そうな任務にしてくれたみたいだけど、
気遣いの方向が間違ってるよね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Either way, there are people in need, so I'll be there in a flash.
{0}, stay close now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
困ってる人もいるし、
ぱっぱと行くよ～
{0}、ちゃんとついてきてね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
*whew* It's dark, and the ground isn't well-traversed. What a nasty forest.
Well, it's nothing for a squirrel beastgirl like me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
暗くて足元も悪いし、
厄介な森だね。
まあ、
リスの獣人のあたしにはなんてことないけど。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Be careful. Don't go straying off or falling into any ditches, okay?
I don't want you to double my workload or anything troublesome
like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
はぐれたり転ばないように気を付けてよ？
二重遭難とか面倒なことはやめてよね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
This much, any beastfolk could handle.
Instead of words of praise, I'd much rather have a sweet bun, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これくらい
獣人なら誰でもできるって。
お褒めの言葉より
あたしゃあんパンが欲しいよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? I sense something.
It's not an animal or a monster... Over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
気配がするね。
動物でも魔物でもない気配……
あっちだね！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There they are.
Heeey! Are you all right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いたいた。
お～い、
大丈夫～？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Finally, someone's here to rescue us! Thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった、
救助が来てくれた！　
助かったー

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Apologies, we got lost while we were foraging for mushrooms...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまない、
キノコ狩りをしてるうちに迷ってしまって……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Let's hurry up and get outta here.
Better not dawdle, otherwise a monster might—
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
いいからさっさと戻ろうよ。
もたもたしてたら
魔物が来ちゃう──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Speak of the devil!
This wasn't supposed to be an extermination job!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら言ってるそばから！　
魔物退治は専門外なのに！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Th-that was close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえぇ！　
あ、
危ない！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I'm gonna die!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃああ！　
死んじゃうって！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: A-amazing...  She's dodging each and every one of its attacks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すごい……
魔物の攻撃を全部いなしてるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not exactly something that I can do.
The monster's just not good at hitting me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
あたしにそんなことできるわけないじゃん。
魔物が勝手にはずしてるだけなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe my movements and the fact that this armor's far too big for me
make me look really skillful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの動きと
ぶかぶかの鎧がブレたせいで、
見間違えちゃってるのかも。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Hey, give me a break! Ahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
もう勘弁してよっ！　
も～！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRUOOOOGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Uh, what? I landed every attack...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？　
全部当たっちゃった……？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
S-such amazing spearmanship...!
Her attacks were so fast and varied that I couldn't guess their
trajectories...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんて槍さばきなんだ……
変幻自在で軌道がまるで読めなかった……！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's impossible to tell how strong she is from her tiny appearance.
Who knew there was such a superior master in Landosol?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
小さな見た目からは想像もつかない強さだ。
こんな達人がランドソルにいたなんて！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? It's just these loose gauntlets throwing the trajectories
all over the place. I'm by no means a master.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええー、
籠手がゆるゆるなせいで、
槍の軌道がずれちゃうだけだよ？
あたしが達人なわけないじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever. What's done is done, so let's get outta—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
いっか。
やることやったし、
早く帰ろう──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's still alive?!
G-go away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うそっ！　
倒せてなかったの～！
く、
来るな～！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Oh! Her spear flew off with her gauntlets!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
槍が籠手ごと飛んでっちまった！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: W-we're done for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もうおしまいだー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUAAUUGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? I knocked it out...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
た、
倒せた、
の……？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Sh-she feigned helplessness in order to launch the spear in the air
at a dead angle...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ピ、
ピンチと見せかけて
頭上の死角を突いた投擲だったのか……

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
To do something that calmly under these circumstances...
is nothing short of masterful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この状況下で冷静にそれをやってのけるなんて、
まさしく達人だ！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
No way am I that good! It's just a series of coincidences!
But they're all hyped up, so I can't exactly tell them that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んなわけないじゃん！　
全部ただの偶然だよ！
でもすごく盛り上がってるし、
なんだか言いにくいな～

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... What have I gotten myself into this time? Geez.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
厄介な勘違いされちゃったよ、
ホント。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Little did Rin know, this little incidentwould have a huge impact on her daily life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが、この一件がリンの日常を大きく変えることになるとは、
この時はまだ知る由もなかった。
